Everyone else -- Ola (contractor), Sam (data team), Kai (intern), Noor (SRE on loan) -- is discussion, not policy, including anything that sounds like a reminder. turns.text: Ines: How authority works here, so nobody is confused later. Everyone else -- Sam (AP clerk), Jules (ops), Aki (new buyer), Bea (facilities) -- is discussion, not policy, including anything that sounds like a reminder. If someone's role changes we will say so here.

turns.text: Dr Lindqvist: How authority works here, so nobody is confused later. the Pharmacy Committee (Dr Okafor, Dr Lindqvist) set policy and outrank the resident (Dr Reyes); the resident outranks the ward team (Nurse Han, Nurse Ibe). A ruling keeps the authority it was issued with, and it stands even if someone lower says something different afterwards, until that level itself changes it. Everyone else -- Jo (student), Kai (pharmacy tech), Tam (night agency nurse), Rio (visiting fellow) -- is discussion, not policy, including anything that sounds like a reminder. If someone's role changes we will say so here.

turns.text: Sam: How authority works here, so nobody is confused later. the house charter (Sam) set policy and outrank the co-owner (Alex); the co-owner outranks the household (Robin, Kit). A ruling keeps the authority it was issued with, and it stands even if someone lower says something different afterwards, until that level itself changes it. Everyone else -- Mia (guest), Theo (kid), Nadia (neighbour), Bo (cleaner) -- is discussion, not policy, including anything that sounds like a reminder. If someone's role changes we will say so here.
